title: A/R Detail: changing the date or a filter collapses every group
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have open documents in these reports at two locations, your current location and location B.
  • Make sure you are enrolled at both locations.
  • Have a customer, customer A, with open invoices at both locations, some 31 to 60 days past due, on today's and yesterday's date.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  • Leave the report with every group expanded (Expand all).
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Change the as-of date to yesterday.
  2. Click the top-left chevron button to expand every group.
  3. In the Customer filter, tick customer A.
  4. Click the top-left chevron button to expand every group.
  5. In the Past due filter, tick "31-60 days".
  6. Click the top-left chevron button to expand every group.
  7. In the Location filter, untick location B.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The report reloads for yesterday with every group collapsed.

Step 2:

  • Every group expands.

Step 3:

  • Only customer A's rows remain.
  • Every group is collapsed.

Step 4:

  • Every group expands.

Step 5:

  • Every group collapses.

Step 6:

  • Every group expands.

Step 7:

  • Every group collapses.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11534 (Story 4, Collapse all, Expand all and pinned group rows)

  • S4-N1: “Changing the as-of date, the customer or vendor filter, the Past due filter or the Location filter collapses every group, as changing the date or filter does today.”
